name: io.github.tonyyang0504/linkedin-ads-mcp
description: LinkedIn Ads (Campaign Manager) (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, update_budget, pause_resum

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client id of a LinkedIn app with the Advertising API product (scopes r_ads, rw_ads).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_LINKEDIN_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The app's client secret (form body of the refresh_token grant at https://www.linkedin.com/oauth/v2/accessToken).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_LINKEDIN_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Programmatic refresh token from the 3-legged flow (available to approved Marketing API partners; valid about one year). The runtime mints 60-day access tokens from it.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_LINKEDIN_AD_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Sponsored ad account id (digits) that owns the campaigns update_budget and pause_resume change (POST /rest/adAccounts/{adAccountId}/adCampaigns/{campaignId}); those verbs take only a campaign id.
